Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 2026. This is a translation for convenience; the German version is legally binding.

1. Controller

The controller for data processing on this website under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is:
EMETRIX Tech, owner Abdul Naasir Obaidy, Eifelstr. 66A, 60529 Frankfurt am Main, Germany
Email: contact@emetrix-tech.com

2. Principles

We only process personal data as far as needed to provide a working website and our content and services. This website uses no tracking cookies, no analytics tools and no advertising pixels. Fonts are loaded locally from our own server; no connection is made to Google Fonts or other font providers.

3. Hosting and content delivery (Cloudflare)

This website is served via Cloudflare Pages and delivered and protected by the network of Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend St., San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. When you visit, Cloudflare processes technically necessary data such as IP address, date and time of access, requested page, referrer URL and browser and operating system information, to deliver the website securely and efficiently and to fend off attacks (e.g. DDoS).

The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; our legitimate interest is the secure, fast and stable provision of our website. Cloudflare is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, and standard contractual clauses are in place. A data processing agreement exists with Cloudflare. More: cloudflare.com/privacypolicy.

4. Contact by email

If you contact us by email, including via the contact form, which only opens your own email app with a pre-filled message, we process your details (e.g. name, email address, company, message) to handle your request. The form itself does not store or transmit any data to our server.

The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR where your request relates to entering into or performing a contract, otherwise Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. We delete your data once it is no longer needed and no statutory retention obligations apply.

5. Local browser storage

To remember your language choice, the website may create an entry in your browser's local storage. It is never sent to us and can be deleted at any time in your browser settings. The legal basis is § 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG, as this storage is strictly necessary for the service you requested.

6. Your rights

You have the right of access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and to object (Art. 21). Contact us at the email address above.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. Ours is: Der Hessische Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit, Gustav-Stresemann-Ring 1, 65189 Wiesbaden, Germany.

7. TLS encryption

For security, this website uses TLS encryption, shown by "https://" in your browser's address bar.

8. Changes

We update this policy whenever changes to the website or the law require it.
